parts.problem_md:
Measure the length of the line $AB$ 
Give your answer in centimetres.

![Line segment labelled 'A' on the left and 'B' on the right, representing a straight horizontal connection between two points.](assets/008-line-segment-labelled-a-on-the-left-and-b-on-the.png)
parts.solution_md:
> *Carefully line your ruler up with the zero on the end of the line at A*

> *Read off the number of the end of the line at B*

**Final answer:** **8.6**

**[B1]**

> **[mark-scheme]**
> **B1:** Answers in the range 8.4-8.8 will get this mark.

parts.problem_md:
Here is a sketch of triangle $ABC$

![Triangle ABC with sides BC 6.5cm, AC 8cm; angle at C is 38 degrees. Note: Diagram not accurately drawn.](assets/002-triangle-abc-with-sides-bc-6-5cm-ac-8cm-angle-at.png)

$AC=8\mathrm{cm}BC=6.5\mathrm{cm} \mathrm{angle}ACB=38^{\circ}$

In the space below, make an accurate drawing of triangle $ABC$
The line $AC$ has been drawn for you.

![Horizontal line segment labelled A on the left end and C on the right end, against a white background.](assets/003-horizontal-line-segment-labelled-a-on-the-left-e.png)
parts.solution_md:
> *Line up your protractor horizontally with the centre cross on C*

> *Measure round from the zero nearest A until you get to 38° and mark that point*

![A protractor measuring a 38-degree angle with line AC and segment. A clear ruler is aligned below, showing measurements in centimetres.](assets/004-a-protractor-measuring-a-38-degree-angle-with-li.png)

> *Line up your ruler between C and your mark keeping 0 on C*

![A transparent ruler is positioned diagonally over a horizontal line labelled A to C, forming an acute angle.](assets/005-a-transparent-ruler-is-positioned-diagonally-ove.jpg)

> *Draw a line 6.5cm long keeping your ruler in that position*

![A transparent ruler measures a black line forming an angle with a horizontal line from point A to C, with markings in centimetres visible on the ruler.](assets/006-a-transparent-ruler-measures-a-black-line-formin.jpg)

Join the end and the end of your line with a straight line to complete the triangle

![Illustration of triangle ACD, with a thick black line along AC.](assets/007-illustration-of-triangle-acd-with-a-thick-black-.jpg)

**[B1 B1]**

> **[mark-scheme]**
> **B1: **For correctly marking an angle of 38° or measuring a line BC of 6.5cm. Your angle must be in the range of 36°-40°. BC must be in the range of 6.3cm-6.7cm.
> 
> **B1:** Your complete triangle accurately drawn within the ranges given in the first mark.

parts.problem_md:
The scale drawing shows the positions of two airports $P$ and $Q$

![Line connecting points P and Q with north arrows at each, scale 1 cm to 50 km, illustrating distance or direction on a map.](assets/001-line-connecting-points-p-and-q-with-north-arrows.png)

Find, by measuring, the bearing of $P$ from $Q$
parts.solution_md:
> *Line your protractor up on Q with 0° on the North line and the cross in the middle of your protractor on Q*

> *Measure round from 0 to the line that goes to P*

**Final answer:** **104°**

**[B1]**

> **[mark-scheme]**
> **B1:** Answers in the range 102-106 will be accepted.

parts.problem_md:
A small plane flies directly from $P$ to $Q$
The plane takes 2 hours to fly from $P$ to $Q$

Work out the average speed of the plane. 
Give your answer in km/ h
parts.solution_md:
> *Measure the distance between P and Q*

*9.4 cm*

> *Using the scale 1cm = 50km, convert to km*

$9.4\times50=470\mathrm{km}$

**[M1]**

> *speed = distance ÷ time*

*speed *$=470\div2$

**[M1]**

**Final answer:** **235**

**[A1]**

> **[mark-scheme]**
> **A1:** Answers in the range 230-240 will be accepted.

parts.problem_md:
Here is an accurate scale drawing showing the positions of a hotel and a museum.

![Diagram showing directions from a museum to a hotel. Two arrows indicate north. The path forms a diagonal line between the museum and the hotel.](assets/009-diagram-showing-directions-from-a-museum-to-a-ho.png)

Scale: 1 cm represents 4.5 km

Find, by measuring, the bearing of the hotel from the museum.
parts.solution_md:
> **[exam-tip]**
> Remember the three rules for bearings:
> 
> 1. Measured from North.
> 2. Measured clockwise.
> 3. Written with 3 digits.

> *Line your protractor up with the 0 on the North line of the museum and measure the angle*

![A protractor image showing a direction from a museum to a hotel. The angle measurement is indicated, and both points have north arrows.](assets/010-a-protractor-image-showing-a-direction-from-a-mu.png)

$030^{\circ}$

**[B1]**

> **[mark-scheme]**
> **B1: **Answers between 28-32 are accepted.

parts.problem_md: Work out the real distance between the hotel and the museum.
parts.solution_md:
> *Use your ruler to measure the distance on the paper*

![Diagonal ruler marked in centimetres with two labelled points: "museum" at 1.5 cm and "hotel" at 7.5 cm, arrows indicating northward orientation.](assets/011-diagonal-ruler-marked-in-centimetres-with-two-la.png)

> *The distance on paper is 8cm *

$1\mathrm{cm}=4.5\mathrm{km}\,8\mathrm{cm}=4.5\mathrm{km}\times8$

**[M1]**

**Final answer:** **36km**

**[A1]**

> **[mark-scheme]**
> **M1: **7.8-8.2 allowed
> 
> **A1: **35-37 allowed
